title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: An attacker can bypass authentication and gain unauthorized administrator access without knowing the correct password.
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and enforce secure server-side authentication checks.

title: SQL Injection Data Extraction

impact: An attacker can retrieve sensitive database information including 21 user email addresses and password hashes through a UNION-based injection.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and apply least-privilege database access controls.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: An attacker can execute malicious JavaScript in a victim browser through a crafted order-tracking URL potentially enabling session compromise and page manipulation.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and avoid inserting untrusted input into executable HTML.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
impact: An attacker can store malicious JavaScript in a product description through the API potentially causing code execution when the saved content is rendered.
remediation: Sanitize untrusted HTML and implement context-aware output encoding and a restrictive Content Security Policy.
